{{Quote|T-that '''cry''' touched my '''emergency reactivator--''' the next thing I '''beheld''' was Master Luke-- '''shut down!'''|C-3PO|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 18">[[Star Wars (1977) 18|''Star Wars'' (1977) 18]]</ref>}}
An '''emergency reactivator''' was a component of some [[Droid/Legends|droids]] which reactivated them from shut down mode when triggered by emergencies, such as a cry of distress. [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] was equipped with an emergency reactivator.
